brief: Interior floorboards for the Mayor's Hall. Planks run horizontally. Must tile seamlessly on all four edges. This is most of the screen indoors, so keep the grain quiet; boards that read as stripes at 3x zoom get exhausting.
sketchNote: Four planks, four rows each: light edge, two mid rows, shadow edge. The # is the end seam between boards, staggered so the tile repeats without a visible grid.
